184:            [False,  True,  True,  True,  True, False],
185:            [False, False,  True,  True,  True, False],
186:            [False, False, False, False, False,  True]])
187: 
188:     """
189:     be = instantiate_backend(be)
190: 
191:     if be.is_numpy:
192:         mask = _njit_itakura_mask(sz1, sz2, max_slope=max_slope)
193:     else:
194:         mask = _itakura_mask(sz1, sz2, max_slope=max_slope)
195: 
196:     return mask
197: 
198: 
199: def compute_mask(
200:     s1,
201:     s2,
202:     global_constraint=0,
203:     sakoe_chiba_radius=None,
204:     itakura_max_slope=None,
205:     be=None,
206: ):
207:     r"""Compute the mask (region constraint).
208: 
209:     Parameters
210:     ----------
211:     s1 : array-like, shape=(sz1, d) or (sz1,) or int
212:         A time series or integer.
213:         If shape is (sz1,), the time series is assumed to be univariate.
214:         If int, size sz1 used to dimension the mask.
215:     s2 : array-like, shape=(sz2, d) or (sz2,) or int
216:         Another time series or integer.
217:         If shape is (sz2,), the time series is assumed to be univariate.
218:         If int, size sz2 used to dimension the mask.
219:     global_constraint : {0, 1, 2} (default: 0)
220:         Global constraint to restrict admissible paths for DTW:
221:         - "itakura" if 1
222:         - "sakoe_chiba" if 2
223:         - no constraint otherwise
224:     sakoe_chiba_radius : int or None (default: None)
225:         Radius to be used for Sakoe-Chiba band global constraint.
226:         The Sakoe-Chiba radius corresponds to the parameter :math:`\delta` mentioned in [1]_,
227:         it controls how far in time we can go in order to match a given
228:         point from one time series to a point in another time series.
229:         If None and `global_constraint` is set to 2 (sakoe-chiba), a radius of
230:         1 is used.
231:         If both `sakoe_chiba_radius` and `itakura_max_slope` are set,
232:         `global_constraint` is used to infer which constraint to use among the
233:         two. In this case, if `global_constraint` corresponds to no global
234:         constraint, a `RuntimeWarning` is raised and no global constraint is
235:         used.
236:     itakura_max_slope : float or None (default: None)
237:         Maximum slope for the Itakura parallelogram constraint.
238:         If None and `global_constraint` is set to 1 (itakura), a maximum slope
239:         of 2. is used.
240:         If both `sakoe_chiba_radius` and `itakura_max_slope` are set,
241:         `global_constraint` is used to infer which constraint to use among the
242:         two. In this case, if `global_constraint` corresponds to no global
243:         constraint, a `RuntimeWarning` is raised and no global constraint is
244:         used.
245:     be : Backend object or string or None
246:         Backend. If `be` is an instance of the class `NumPyBackend` or the string `"numpy"`,
247:         the NumPy backend is used.
248:         If `be` is an instance of the class `PyTorchBackend` or the string `"pytorch"`,
249:         the PyTorch backend is used.
250:         If `be` is `None`, the backend is determined by the input arrays.
251:         See our :ref:`dedicated user-guide page <backend>` for more information.
252: 
253:     Returns
254:     -------
255:     mask : array-like, shape=(sz1, sz2)
256:         Constraint region.
257: 
258:     Examples
259:     --------
260:     >>> compute_mask(4, 4)
261:     array([[ True,  True,  True,  True],
262:            [ True,  True,  True,  True],
263:            [ True,  True,  True,  True],
264:            [ True,  True,  True,  True]])
265:     >>> compute_mask(4, 4, sakoe_chiba_radius=1)
266:     array([[ True,  True, False, False],
267:            [ True,  True,  True, False],
268:            [False,  True,  True,  True],
269:            [False, False,  True,  True]])
270:     >>> compute_mask(4, 4, itakura_max_slope=2)
271:     array([[ True, False, False, False],
272:            [False,  True,  True, False],
273:            [False,  True,  True, False],
274:            [False, False, False,  True]])
275: 
276:     References
277:     ----------
278:     .. [1] H. Sakoe, S. Chiba, "Dynamic programming algorithm optimization for
279:            spoken word recognition," IEEE Transactions on Acoustics, Speech and
280:            Signal Processing, vol. 26(1), pp. 43--49, 1978.
281:     """
282:     be = instantiate_backend(be, s1, s2)
283: 
284:     # The output mask will be of shape (sz1, sz2)
285:     if isinstance(s1, int) and isinstance(s2, int):
286:         sz1, sz2 = s1, s2
287:     else:
288:         sz1 = len(s1)
289:         sz2 = len(s2)
290: 
291:     if be.is_numpy:
292:         x = _njit_compute_mask(
293:             sz1,
294:             sz2,
295:             global_constraint,
296:             sakoe_chiba_radius,
297:             itakura_max_slope,
298:         )
299:         return x
300:     else:
301:         return _compute_mask(
302:             sz1,
303:             sz2,
304:             global_constraint,
305:             sakoe_chiba_radius,
306:             itakura_max_slope,
307:         )
308: 
309: 
310: def __make_compute_mask(backend):
311:     if backend is numpy:
312:         sakoe_chiba_mask_ = _njit_sakoe_chiba_mask
313:         itakura_mask_ = _njit_itakura_mask
314:     else:
315:         sakoe_chiba_mask_ = _sakoe_chiba_mask
316:         itakura_mask_ = _itakura_mask
317: 
318:     def _compute_mask_generic(
319:             sz1,
320:             sz2,
321:             global_constraint=0,
322:             sakoe_chiba_radius=None,
323:             itakura_max_slope=None,
324:     ):
325:         if (
326:                 global_constraint == 0
327:                 and sakoe_chiba_radius is not None
328:                 and itakura_max_slope is not None
329:         ):
330:             raise RuntimeWarning(
331:                 "global_constraint is not set for DTW, but both "
332:                 "sakoe_chiba_radius and itakura_max_slope are "
333:                 "set, hence global_constraint cannot be inferred "
334:                 "and no global constraint will be used."
335:             )
336:         if global_constraint == 2 or (
337:                 global_constraint == 0 and sakoe_chiba_radius is not None
338:         ):
339:             if sakoe_chiba_radius is None:
